subject: Trouble shooting 0 speed from points from camera trap data

messages.author: fa9b875eb829edc8
messages.subject: Trouble shooting 0 speed from points from camera trap data
parts:
Hey group,

We have been trying to use the ctmm code from x,y coordinate points we have been getting from deer on camera traps. Everything in the code seems to be working but we are getting 0 for the speed. We saw a previous thread saying either something is wrong with our points or we don't have fine enough data. Since we are getting movement points every second we should have appropriate data but were thinking our data isnt structured properly for the code. 

Any suggestions would be greatly appreciated!
Sierra McMurry

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Trouble shooting 0 speed from points from camera trap data
parts:
Hi Sierra,

You can track their (x,y) coordinates within each camera trap's detection area or you have the coordinates of each camera trap they are detected at? The latter might not work and will need an error model.
Otherwise, what does the variogram look like and what is the selected model?

The line
telemetry_data$error <- 0.5
is not going to do anything. See the error vignette for help with modeling location error.

Best,
Chris
